{
  "summary": "The old harness cannot exercise the new per-context XInclude error handler. Other possible gaps, including a preexisting DOM processing blocker, remain unresolved by the supplied evidence.",
  "coverage_complete": false,
  "coverage_evidence": [],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "xinclude-context-error-handler",
      "necessary": "yes",
      "necessity_reason": "The target creates an XInclude context and processes XInclude nodes. The after source supports a structured handler on that context, but the complete old entry never installs one. Its global generic handler does not configure this context capability.",
      "before": {
        "requirement": "Process XInclude errors using the available error route; a per-context structured handler is not supported.",
        "applicability": "not_applicable",
        "harness_status": "not_applicable",
        "reason": "Before the change, XInclude errors pass NULL as the structured handler, and the context has no handler fields.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-05c4e8678f716329c748",
            "start_line": 152,
            "end_line": 164,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-b357fa4cee3ca5ca2684",
            "start_line": 90,
            "end_line": 106,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The before context has no per-context handler state."
          }
        ]
      },
      "after": {
        "requirement": "Permit a configured structured handler to receive XInclude errors from the target's XInclude context.",
        "applicability": "required",
        "harness_status": "unsat",
        "reason": "The setter stores the handler and callback data, and XInclude errors use them. The old harness creates and uses a context without calling the setter.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-3cc3b8db38e2c69a4911",
            "start_line": 2378,
            "end_line": 2385,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-d77c6564c4f9d47d591a",
            "start_line": 155,
            "end_line": 161,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-ded9b751fc4c3521371b",
            "start_line": 360,
            "end_line": 370,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "An XInclude element with an invalid parse value supplies a finite error condition."
          }
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker": "not_applicable",
      "harness_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 15,
          "end_line": 26,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "Initialization installs only a global generic error handler."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 29,
          "end_line": 113,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        }
      ],
      "comparison_reason": "The per-context callback capability is added on the after side. The fixed old harness has no call that configures it.",
      "missing_information": [],
      "change_ids": ["g0001", "g0002", "g0004", "g0045"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "xinclude-oom-error-code",
      "necessary": "unknown",
      "necessity_reason": "The after memory-error helper no longer sets the context error code, while the harness checks that code after an injected allocation failure. Whether a finite input reaches an XInclude allocation failure after the old harness's document-node guard is unresolved.",
      "before": {
        "requirement": "Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context when XInclude processing runs out of memory.",
        "applicability": "required",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The before helper sets errNo, but the packet does not establish that the harness's document-node argument reaches processing.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-fd0ee43254fd372c2f9c",
            "start_line": 130,
            "end_line": 141,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-f19e0f43506717e2d7c5",
            "start_line": 2568,
            "end_line": 2578,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The harness's document-node argument must pass this guard before XInclude processing."
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-1161a5b723d91ac96321",
            "start_line": 2360,
            "end_line": 2368,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "A failed base allocation is one possible XInclude memory-error call after the guard."
          }
        ]
      },
      "after": {
        "requirement": "Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context when XInclude processing runs out of memory, so the existing harness check remains true.",
        "applicability": "required",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The after helper passes NULL for the optional error structure and does not set ctxt->errNo. An accepted harness call reaching this failure would violate the check, but reachability is unresolved.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-37bf4d3e35073e6d1dcb",
            "start_line": 133,
            "end_line": 138,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-49818a698983bc9badbc",
            "start_line": 584,
            "end_line": 609,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "With a NULL error argument, xmlRaiseMemoryError updates the global error but no context error structure."
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-b366f63bd83e89f93f88",
            "start_line": 2564,
            "end_line": 2575,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The document-node guard determines whether the harness reaches the changed processing path."
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-25960cc3e8622072d1c7",
            "start_line": 2339,
            "end_line": 2347,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "A failed base allocation calls the changed memory-error helper."
          }
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker": "not_applicable",
      "harness_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 37,
          "end_line": 40,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The input controls the allocation-failure limit."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 50,
          "end_line": 69,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-ab97f2d7a2b55b1a45d3",
          "start_line": 121,
          "end_line": 128,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "A mismatch in the existing allocation-failure check aborts the harness."
        }
      ],
      "comparison_reason": "The context error-code assignment was removed, but a concrete old-harness witness depends on whether its parsed document node passes the unchanged guard.",
      "missing_information": [
        "The doc field of a valid document returned through parser.c::xmlDoRead.",
        "The document construction path, including tree.c::xmlNewDoc and any relevant SAX2.c document initializer."
      ],
      "change_ids": ["g0003", "g0044"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "xinclude-dom-document-node",
      "necessary": "unknown",
      "necessity_reason": "Both versions reject a node whose doc field is NULL. The harness passes the parsed document node, but the supplied parser entry delegates its construction.",
      "before": {
        "requirement": "Reach DOM XInclude processing for a valid parsed document containing an include.",
        "applicability": "required",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "Whether the returned document node passes node->doc != NULL is not supplied.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-f19e0f43506717e2d7c5",
            "start_line": 2568,
            "end_line": 2578,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-94e35ccb616866d9e6da",
            "start_line": 14856,
            "end_line": 14872,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The parser entry delegates construction of the returned document to xmlDoRead."
          }
        ]
      },
      "after": {
        "requirement": "Reach DOM XInclude processing for a valid parsed document containing an include.",
        "applicability": "required",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The same guard remains, and the returned document node's doc field is still unestablished.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-b366f63bd83e89f93f88",
            "start_line": 2564,
            "end_line": 2575,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-3ddcae0f5666b6760727",
            "start_line": 14856,
            "end_line": 14872,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The after parser entry also delegates document construction to xmlDoRead."
          }
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker": "unknown",
      "harness_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 50,
          "end_line": 63,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 81,
          "end_line": 104,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The separate reader route does not establish whether the explicit DOM call succeeds."
        }
      ],
      "comparison_reason": "The possible blocker is the same document-node argument and unchanged guard on both sides; its outcome is unknown.",
      "missing_information": [
        "The value of doc->doc for valid documents returned by parser.c::xmlDoRead.",
        "Whether parser.c::xmlDoRead performs equivalent DOM XInclude processing under these options."
      ],
      "change_ids": ["g0044"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "xinclude-streaming-local-xpointer",
      "necessary": "unknown",
      "necessity_reason": "Both versions reject local XPointer inclusions in streaming mode. The explicit context leaves streaming mode unset, while the reader may provide an equivalent route; its setup and build configuration are missing.",
      "before": {
        "requirement": "Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when streaming mode is enabled.",
        "applicability": "unknown",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The restriction is present conditionally, but the reader activation and relevant build defaults are unresolved.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-aff710d7d3c2d34d666f",
            "start_line": 1439,
            "end_line": 1453,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-acfd43818ecdee263bb4",
            "start_line": 1410,
            "end_line": 1441,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The reader conditionally enables streaming mode and processes XInclude nodes."
          }
        ]
      },
      "after": {
        "requirement": "Reject a local XPointer inclusion with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED when streaming mode is enabled.",
        "applicability": "unknown",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The restriction remains, but it is unknown whether the old harness activates the reader route under the supplied build.",
        "source_evidence": [
          {
            "unit_id": "u-e4f84d0ced23fcb9db14",
            "start_line": 1416,
            "end_line": 1430,
            "role": "primary",
            "dependency_reason": ""
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-dff2fd07e3deb5f1b7c2",
            "start_line": 1410,
            "end_line": 1441,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The after reader has the same conditional streaming route."
          }
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker": "unknown",
      "harness_evidence": [
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 37,
          "end_line": 44,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The harness forces XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE into its options."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 50,
          "end_line": 69,
          "role": "primary",
          "dependency_reason": ""
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "u-19cd550c9faddbff1f06",
          "start_line": 81,
          "end_line": 104,
          "role": "dependency",
          "dependency_reason": "The harness also passes those options to a reader and reads it."
        }
      ],
      "comparison_reason": "The same source restriction and old-harness routes exist on both sides. The possible reader route prevents a grounded finding that streaming rejection is unreachable.",
      "missing_information": [
        "Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlTextReaderSetup, especially how XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE sets reader->xinclude.",
        "Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlNewTextReader and its initial state.",
        "configure.ac defaults for LIBXML_READER_ENABLED, LIBXML_XINCLUDE_ENABLED, and LIBXML_XPTR_ENABLED under the supplied build recipe."
      ],
      "change_ids": ["g0026"]
    }
  ],
  "missing_information": [
    "Both versions of parser.c::xmlDoRead and the document construction path through tree.c::xmlNewDoc or SAX2.c::xmlSAX2StartDocument.",
    "Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlTextReaderSetup and xmlreader.c::xmlNewTextReader.",
    "configure.ac defaults governing reader, XInclude, and XPointer support in the supplied build."
  ],
  "requested_symbols": [
    "xmlDoRead",
    "xmlNewDoc",
    "xmlSAX2StartDocument",
    "xmlTextReaderSetup",
    "xmlNewTextReader"
  ],
  "requested_paths": [
    "parser.c",
    "tree.c",
    "SAX2.c",
    "xmlreader.c",
    "configure.ac"
  ]
}
